a: Ask functional and non-functional requirements before designing.
Estimate QPS, storage, bandwidth, and growth to size components.
Define main endpoints and core data entities early.
Choose SQL/NoSQL, keys, indexes, and consistency needs.
Draw clients, gateways, services, caches, queues, and databases.
Identify single points of failure and hot partitions.
Explicitly discuss consistency, latency, cost, and complexity trade-offs.
Plan for node death, network partitions, and dependency outages.
Cover authn/authz, encryption, and abuse prevention.
Define SLIs, alerts, and dashboards for the system.
